references.provenance: Exact selected source restored by root from matching local Git LFS object; personally opened.

silhouette: Broad human monastic silhouette, rust-orange shoulder cape over long charcoal-brown robe, off-white central tunic panels, wide brown multi-buckle belt, strapped dark brown footwear.
anatomy: Two arms, two hands, two legs; muscular forearms; closely shaved dark scalp. No added clockwork limbs.
face: Warm medium skin, strong straight nose, dark brows, sober expression; closely shaved head with short dark stubble; gold circular mechanical fittings on source-visible temple and ear; small turquoise hanging bead.
costume: Heavy charcoal hood folded at neck, rust cape fastened by two round gold clasps, large circular brass clock medallion at chest, diagonal brown chest strap, dangling chains, pendulum-like belt ornaments, gold-ornamented forearm guards, long opaque charcoal/rust/off-white robe panels.
palette: Dark brown and charcoal, rust orange, aged brass gold, off-white textile, small turquoise accent.
equipment: Single large pendulum maul: very long dark shaft with brass collars; bulky round drum-shaped rust/brown head encased by gold circular rims and a gold central round boss. Full maul in all required scenes; no axe blade or sword substitute. Source anatomical right hand upper shaft, left lower shaft near drum head.

Coordination visual adjudication: source-certain equipment is one long rigid dark shaft, brass collars, large bronze/rust cylindrical disk head, and short chain attachment at disk. The large upper-left arch/cylinder/long vertical chain overlaps clock-city background machinery; its attribution to maul is ambiguous. Do not require or invent that full assembly in every pose. Preserve a small attached cap/hook where legible, keep rigid shaft-to-drum connection, never turn maul into flail. CG01/02 upper assembly is a local compatible interpretation, not certified source geometry.
forbiddenMixes: No blond hair, white shoulder mantle, unarmed young martial artist from previous atlas. No helmet, beard, invented scars, third-party universe symbols, duplicate weapon, extra limbs or fictional hidden back geometry.
